passage.label: Bedouins say believed say not yet believed say submitted faith not yet entered hearts; obey Allah Messenger not deprive deeds anything Forgiving Merciful; believers only believed Allah Messenger doubt not strive properties lives cause Allah truthful; say acquaint Allah religion Allah knows whatever heavens earth Knowing all things; consider favour accepted Islam say do not consider Islam favour me rather Allah conferred favour guided faith truthful; Allah knows unseen heavens earth Seeing what do

arabicExcerpts.text: ۞قَالَتِ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابُ ءَامَنَّاۖ قُل لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ وَلَٰكِن قُولُوٓاْ أَسۡلَمۡنَا وَلَمَّا يَدۡخُلِ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَا يَلِتۡكُم مِّنۡ أَعۡمَٰلِكُمۡ شَيۡـًٔاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ
إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَرۡتَابُواْ وَجَٰهَدُواْ بِأَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ وَأَنفُسِهِمۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّـٰدِقُونَ
قُلۡ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمۡ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ
يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيۡكَ أَنۡ أَسۡلَمُواْۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّواْ عَلَيَّ إِسۡلَٰمَكُمۖ بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ أَنۡ هَدَىٰكُمۡ لِلۡإِيمَٰنِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ غَيۡبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ

mainSubject.label: Bedouins claiming belief told they have only submitted since faith has not yet entered their hearts, with obedience preserving deeds under the Forgiving Merciful; true believers defined as those believing in Allah and His Messenger without doubt and striving with properties and lives in Allah's cause — they are the truthful; the absurdity of acquainting Allah with one's religion when He already knows all in heavens and earth; their consideration of Islam as a favour to the Prophet reversed — Allah conferred the favour by guiding them to faith if they are truthful; closing affirmation that Allah knows the unseen of heavens and earth and sees all deeds

notes: Wave 8 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the bounty-and-favour framing (8) before the inter-believer conflict rules open (9); P2 ends with the universal nobility-by-righteousness declaration (13) before the bedouin iman-submission distinction begins (14); P3 runs from that distinction through the true-believer definition, the favour reversal and the closing unseen-knowledge affirmation (14-18).
